x: John has wintered well, finished 3rd in the A.A.A. indoor mile Championship behind Whetton and Ibbotson, and on 7th May wearing his first A.A.A. vest he clocked 4:10.6 to win the mile against Cambridge U.
After a flat out sprint over the far from flat course he finished 5th behind Whetton,Simpson and D.Taylor in a field of 31 and only 2.6 seconds behind the winner - some warm up!
Apart from that glorious 400m hurdles final and possibly Whetton's determined running in the 1500m, Britain made little or no impression in any of the finals.
